expectedResponseStatuses.notes: Quote-service maps QuoteCreateException validation/policy rejections to 400, and k6 load proof should not fail solely because unseeded local/dev synthetic refs are contract-rejected. Unexpected status rate remains gated separately.

syntheticFixtureMetadata.notes: These values are deterministic test refs only. They do not represent production investors, channels, states, currencies, effective dates, borrower attributes, rates, fees, or eligibility decisions. Local/dev runs must seed matching tenant reference data before using this payload.

privacy.notes: Fixture stores scenario labels, UUID tenant ids, immutable refs, and deterministic synthetic quote request refs only; concrete mortgage pricing rules, borrower values, rates, and investor decisions must come from seeded tenant configuration.
